description: This file defines a Blazor component 'ToastComponent' used to display toast notifications (info, success, warning, error) within a Blazor web application. It subscribes to events from a 'ToastService' to manage toast visibility and styling.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component that displays toast notifications with customizable styles based on the toast level.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for showing and hiding toasts.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles the display of toast messages, sets styles based on toast level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures the CSS classes and heading based on the toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from toast service events to prevent memory leaks.
